en-US.name: Mango Display
en-US.summary: Shows your Mango Display on your Echo Show.
en-US.description: Turns your Echo Show into a Mango Display. Open the skill, enter the code it shows at app.mangodisplay.com, and your display appears on the screen.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Mango Display to show my display

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the skill on an Echo Show. Claim the code shown at testapp.mangodisplay.com.
